_comment: Which audio model to run, and what it expects. Swapping models is editing this file and dropping the .onnx beside it; nothing in the app needs to change. The placeholder (models/placeholder-events.onnx) is still here to point at for a smoke test. This one is musicnn, trained on the Million Song Dataset: 50 tags and a 200-dimensional embedding, which is the number the novelty is measured from.
_noveltyHistory_comment: How many previous windows a novelty is measured against. Sixty was tried, on the theory that a longer memory would measure 'unusual for this song' rather than 'different from a moment ago': measured over four tracks, the distribution barely moved (median 0.063 with four windows, 0.063 with sixty; the same maximum), because the nearest neighbour of a window is always a nearby window whatever the memory is. So it stays short - two seconds, which is what actually carries the change.

features._comment: musicnn's own frontend, from its configuration and extractor: 16 kHz, 96 mel, fft 512, hop 256, librosa's mel filters, log10(10000x+1), no mean/variance removal. The window and filters are the file next to the model rather than anything derived here.
